items.question: What makes Flama unique?
items.answer: Flama is not confined to a single subject; it empowers learning across all disciplines (Languages, IT, Medicine, Law, Certifications). Moreover, Flama provides an open ecosystem where the community contributes and curates specialized decks for any topic.

items.question: What is the mission of Flama?
items.answer: Flama empowers you to craft decks your way while sustaining a daily study habit. Beyond personal learning, it serves as a platform where learners co-create structured, accessible learning repositories.

items.question: Who is Flama for?
items.answer: It is built for anyone who believes in steady daily progress: language learners, certification candidates, professionals memorizing IT architectures, medical terminologies, legal statutes, or any knowledge requiring long-term recall.

items.question: Can I create my own flashcards?
items.answer: Yes. You can define custom NoteTypes, input fields, organize them into deck trees, and customize visual card templates to fit your learning style.

items.question: What is audio used for in Flama?
items.answer: Audio helps develop correct pronunciation, pitch accent, and listening reflexes directly during review rather than relying solely on text.

items.question: Does Flama work well on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. The fully responsive interface is optimized for rapid mobile review sessions as well as in-depth deck management on desktop.

items.question: Will large decks overwhelm me?
items.answer: Flama organizes cards into New, Learn, and Due queues, prioritizing items on the verge of being forgotten so you only study what truly matters today.

items.question: Can I share my decks with others?
items.answer: Yes. The Marketplace supports sharing decks and NoteTypes. Installed decks use logical overlays, keeping source content and your personal study progress completely decoupled.

items.question: Can I export my data to other platforms?
items.answer: Yes. Flama supports standard CSV/TSV import and export, ensuring you always maintain complete ownership of your data.

items.question: Is Flama free to use?
items.answer: Yes. You can register and access all core learning features for free. The Marketplace includes both free and creator-priced decks.
